checks: Three actual real-model stream observations match saved C19 tensor digest, exact prefix, binding, original sequence, class order and predicted class; abs probability difference <=1e-6. Never invoke old execute or all128prefix baseline.

Explicit session end/new monotonic lifecycle token isolates histories even for same opaque run label; old/copied tokens cannot observe or overwrite the new current result. No implicit reset or timing/source claim.
After construction and the first actual observation, fence model/scaler artifact file reads; subsequent actual observations must not reload assets.
Exact bytes/type/length controls reject mutable aliases and length-overriding bytes subclasses so hard bounds cannot be bypassed.

Outputs contain finite12 probabilities, fixed class order/feature encoding, original sequence/binding and explicit zero authority; no A observed_seq, BOOT, acquisition-age, model_candidate or motion_request is manufactured.
